name: Analyze Cfse Cell Proliferation
description: Analyze CFSE-labeled cell samples to quantify cell division and proliferation.
detailed_description: Analyze CFSE-labeled cell samples to quantify cell division and proliferation.
when_to_use: When you need analyze cfse cell proliferation analysis

parameters.fcs_file_path: [Required] Path to the FCS file containing flow cytometry data from CFSE-labeled cells (str)
parameters.cfse_channel: [Optional] Name of the channel containing CFSE fluorescence data (default: FL1-A)
parameters.lymphocyte_gate: [Optional] Tuple of (min_fsc, max_fsc, min_ssc, max_ssc) for lymphocyte gating
